config.calibration_protocol: fit on val predictions only; applied to test
config.elo_mapping: DiriEloMapper fit on train+val Elo history

notes: Phase-24 audit confirmed Phase-23 split integrity (train=2015/16, val=2016/17, test=2019/20; 380 each).
Calibrators fit on val predictions only; isotonic falls back to identity if a class has <10 positives (small-sample guard).
Elo mapped to 3-class via a Dirichlet-style linear-softmax map fit on train+val; NOT treated as native calibrated probabilities.
Ensemble weights selected on validation log-loss; test never used.
DC rho=0 (MLE on train) collapses DC to independent Poisson; preserved as the faithful Phase-23 result.
COVID-19 stationarity caveat inherited from Phase 23.
